name: Client Report Dashboard
body:
> Project · 2026-10-21

# Summary
The TAG monthly client performance report: a Claude Dashboard artifact (claude.ai/artifact/PzY1Bw1DUyBKXRaJJVby9p). `tag-client-report-dashboard\` is the editable copy of its page code and data files (git repo; README clone URL on GitHub `kimtagmktg/tag-client-report-dashboard`). Commits run Oct 17 to 21, 2026.

# What the report shows
Month over month (a full month vs the month before), shown only after the month ends. Clients: Alphalete Trenchless, Summit Plumbing Pros, Pipeliners; reports start with September 2026 vs August.
- **Report tab:** 1 This Month at a Glance (new leads, jobs booked, revenue, Google clicks, one-line summary), 2 Leads and Bookings by source, 3 Revenue (CRM attributed, per booked job, by source), 4 What Has Changed (before/now table, search trend, keyword and Maps ranks), 5 What Is Next (up to 3 priorities).
- **Details tab:** A Where We Started (challenges, audit scorecard), B Our Plan to Improve, C What We Did (plan progress, highlights, full work log).

# Data sources
| Data | Alphalete | Summit | Pipeliners |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clicks, impressions (US only) | GSC alphaletetrenchless.com | GSC www.summitplumbingpros.com | GSC pipelinersusa.com |
| Keyword ranks (10 each) | Rank tracker 82050 | Project 84536 (Mesa, Chandler, Fountain Hills, Queen Creek) | Project 34164 (Phoenix, Mesa) |
| Maps rank | Grid "trenchless plumbers in colorado" (39 pins) | Avg of 2 grids | Avg of 4 grids |
| Leads, jobs booked, revenue | [Keystone CRM](lib:brain-keystone-crm) via Chrome | Keystone | Keystone |

# Folders
`page/` (index, CSS, `report.js` with calculations), `alp/` (Alphalete data and builders), `clients/` (Summit and Pipeliners data), `crm/` (Keystone leads, bookings, revenue, attribution), `gsc/`, `local/` (heatmaps), `monthly/` (diagnosis, scorecard, plan progress, work log), `scheduled-task/`, `test_calcs.js` (checks the math), `build_docs.py` (wraps page files for upload).

# Monthly scheduled task
On the 2nd of each month, append last month's Search Atlas and Keystone data for all three clients. Rules: never change existing rows, whole calendar months only, unreadable values are null (never 0), stop on any failure rather than writing partial data, do not refresh rank scans (uses quota). Keyword sets were approved Oct 19, 2026. The task only runs on the original PC while the app is open.

# Report rules
One full calendar month per period, month over month only, missing data shows "Not available", no prices or phone numbers.
